customer_api_invalid_token.notes: Authorization header present but not a parseable Bearer value (HTTP 401).

customer_api_token_no_stores.notes: Customer token row exists but StoreIds is empty/missing (HTTP 409).

customer_api_forbidden_store.notes: Device exists but its Group is not in the caller token's StoreIds (HTTP 403).

customer_api_invalid_query_param.notes: Caller-supplied query string parameter (limit / cursor on /jobs) is missing-shape, out-of-range, or unparseable (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_invalid_body.notes: POST /commands body is unparseable, missing commandType, or has malformed required fields (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_unsupported_type.notes: POST /commands commandType is not in the supported set (print-label, upsert-product, delete-product, upsert-template, delete-template) (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_invalid_quantity.notes: POST /commands quantity is not an integer in [1, 999] (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_invalid_product.notes: POST /commands upsert-product body is missing/invalid (bad code, name, categoryName or priceCents) (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_invalid_template.notes: POST /commands upsert-template body is missing/invalid (bad code, name, body) (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_invalid_id.notes: POST /commands delete-product / delete-template / upsert-* given a non-positive or non-integer id field (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_product_not_found.notes: POST /commands productCode is not present in the device's catalog mirror (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_template_not_found.notes: POST /commands templateCode (when provided) is not present in the device's catalog mirror (HTTP 400).

customer_api_command_not_found.notes: GET /commands/{id} row is missing or belongs to a different DeviceCode (HTTP 404).
